actual: Composer raises strategy does not support parameter num_threads; failed loops have experiment_id=null and no CPU training starts.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: MA-E54 本轮首次显式设置 LGBM model_params.num_threads=12；ConfigComposer 未将该键归为 LGBModel 参数，因而泄漏至策略 kwargs，在训练前拒绝全部 12 个 node1 Loop。此前注册模型的默认 num_threads=24 直接来自模型目录，不经过该覆盖入口。数据集、因子和 HMM 不是本次根因。

events.note: 旧代码默认模型与目录模型两项精确 RED 复现 num_threads 错传策略。第一轮补齐 LGB 参数路由；第二轮兼容性审核和 RED 测试发现全局过滤会改变非 LGB 模型的策略行为，进一步限定仅 LGBModel 消费 num_threads。最终四项路由、默认值、目录覆盖、请求隔离、完整 YAML 等价和未知策略 fail-closed 合同通过。无数据集变更、无训练/回测启动、未重试失败 Loop、未影响当前 WSL 实验。
DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001：①真实 Composer 路由完整修复，无占位/简化；②未知策略参数继续显式拒绝，无静默丢弃；③显式线程覆盖以外模型、因子、seed、标签、日期、股票池、成本、TWAP、尾盘处理、HMM/风险政策不变，非 LGB 自定义策略语义保持；④未新增门禁、审批、环境锁或资源硬上限。测试只生成配置，不在 Windows 执行实际 QE 实验。

evidence_uris: qe_20261013_024708_2cff: Loop2 and all 12 node1 LGBM arms fail at ConfigComposer._compose_conf_yaml before submission; source default num_threads=24, new explicit override=12.
expected: Explicit LGBM num_threads overrides must reach task.model.kwargs only; defaults, seeds, dataset, time splits, portfolio and minute TWAP execution must remain unchanged, and unknown strategy keys must still fail closed.
